Pollution and Labor Productivity: Evidence from Chilean Cities
abstract: This paper investigates the effects of pollution on labor productivity in Chile. Data on fine particulate matter pollution in Chile were collected and matched to sectoral labor productivity at the city level. The endogeneity between labor productivity and pollution is controlled for by instrumenting on the presence of coal and diesel power plants. The paper finds that pollution reduces labor productivity. A series of robustness checks demonstrate that pollution has a statistically significant effect on productivity when the analysis controls for labor costs and entry rates. The paper provides extensive evidence to support a causal interpretation of this finding. The identification strategy is based on a stylized macroeconomic model. The pollution elasticity of labor productivity is used to demonstrate how the co-benefits of reducing pollution can be incorporated into mitigation policies in a general equilibrium framework.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了污染对智利劳动生产率的影响。我们收集了智利细颗粒物污染数据，并将其与城市层面的部门劳动生产率相匹配。通过以燃煤和柴油发电厂的存在作为工具变量，我们控制了劳动生产率与污染之间的内生性。本文发现，污染降低了劳动生产率。一系列稳健性检验表明，在控制了劳动成本和进入率之后，污染对生产率仍具有统计上显著的影响。本文提供了大量证据支持对这一发现作因果解释。识别策略基于一个程式化的宏观经济模型。污染对劳动生产率的弹性被用于说明，如何在一般均衡框架下将减污的协同效益纳入减缓政策之中。

Renewable Technology Adoption Costs and Economic Growth
abstract: In the presence of rapid technological progress, early technology adoption may result in large capital replacement costs. We develop an analytical Integrated Assessment Model that incorporates endogenous scrapping costs resulting from new technology adoption in renewable energy, as well as externalities associated with carbon emissions and renewable technology spillovers. We use our calibrated model to investigate the effects of the scrapping channel on renewable technology adoption and on the optimal energy transition. In the absence of a Pigouvian carbon tax, a second-best policy that incentivizes renewables through internalizing spillovers provides relatively small benefits and can even be detrimental to short-run growth. In contrast, the reduction in fossil fuel consumption resulting from internalizing technology spillovers is significantly larger if the Pigouvian tax is also in place. Comparing the status quo to the scenario where both policies are implemented results in a consumption-equivalent welfare gain of 1.4 percent. Our findings suggest that, in the presence of scrapping costs resulting from rapid technological progress, some caution might be warranted before concluding that direct subsidies are a suitable substitute for a Pigouvian carbon tax. When it comes to social welfare, carbon taxes and policies that promote renewables by eliminating spillover externalities are best thought of as complements rather than substitutes. • We use an Analytical Integrated Assessment Model to study the optimal energy transition. • We incorporate scrapping costs resulting from new renewable technology adoption. • At the optimum, such costs discourage heavy early investment in renewable energy capital. • As renewables become more productive, it becomes efficient to invest more in renewables. • Carbon taxes and policies that promote renewables are complementary.
abstract_zh: 在技术快速进步的背景下，早期采用技术可能导致巨额的资本重置成本。我们构建了一个分析性的综合评估模型（Integrated Assessment Model），该模型纳入了因采用可再生能源新技术而产生的内生报废成本，以及与碳排放和可再生技术溢出相关的外部性。我们利用校准后的模型考察了报废渠道对可再生技术采用和最优能源转型的影响。在没有庇古碳税的情况下，通过内部化溢出效应来激励可再生能源的次优政策所带来的收益相对较小，甚至可能不利于短期增长。相比之下，如果同时实施庇古税，内部化技术溢出所导致的化石燃料消费减少幅度会显著更大。与现状相比，同时实施两项政策的情形可带来相当于1.4%的消费等价福利增益。我们的研究结果表明，在存在因快速技术进步而产生报废成本的情况下，在断定直接补贴是庇古碳税的合适替代品之前，或许应当保持谨慎。就社会福利而言，碳税与通过消除溢出外部性来促进可再生能源的政策，最好被视为互补而非替代关系。• 我们使用分析性综合评估模型研究最优能源转型。• 我们纳入了因采用可再生能源新技术而产生的报废成本。• 在最优状态下，此类成本会抑制早期对可再生能源资本的大规模投资。• 随着可再生能源生产率的提高，增加对可再生能源的投资变得更为有效。• 碳税与促进可再生能源的政策具有互补性。

Conservation, Risk Aversion, and Livestock Insurance: the Case of the Snow Leopard
abstract:
Livestock insurance consists of livestock owners pooling resources together in order to hedge against the risk of attacks by predators on their individual herds. We use an economic model to study optimal livestock insurance and to discuss its viability in improving outcomes for livestock owners. The benefit from insurance depends on the livestock owners' level of risk aversion. We calibrate the model using data from
Project Snow Leopard
and investigate the potential of livestock insurance for achieving conservation goals. The model predicts that leopard killings would decline under the proposed livestock insurance contract. The level of the decline depends on the degree of risk aversion. Our analysis calls for surveys that measure risk aversion of local livestock owners to be conducted in any situation where insurance is considered as a policy towards achieving conservation goals. Finally, we discuss how the proposed livestock insurance scheme could be implemented in practice.
abstract_zh: 牲畜保险是指牲畜所有者汇集资源，以对冲其个体畜群遭受捕食者攻击的风险。我们使用一个经济模型来研究最优的牲畜保险，并探讨其在改善牲畜所有者处境方面的可行性。保险的收益取决于牲畜所有者的风险厌恶程度。我们利用雪豹项目（Project Snow Leopard）的数据校准了模型，并考察了牲畜保险实现保护目标的潜力。模型预测，在所提议的牲畜保险合约下，豹子的捕杀数量将会下降。下降的幅度取决于风险厌恶的程度。我们的分析呼吁，在任何将保险视为实现保护目标政策的情境中，都应开展调查以衡量当地牲畜所有者的风险厌恶程度。最后，我们讨论了所提议的牲畜保险方案在实践中可以如何实施。

Employment Impacts of Upstream Oil and Gas Investment in the United States
abstract: Technological progress in the exploration and production of oil and gas during the 2000s has led to a boom in upstream investment and has increased the domestic supply of fossil fuels. It is unknown, however, how many jobs this boom has created. We use time-series methods at the national level and dynamic panel methods at the state-level to understand how the increase in exploration and production activity has impacted employment. We find robust statistical support for the hypothesis that changes in drilling for oil and gas as captured by rig-counts do in fact, have an economically meaningful and positive impact on employment. The strongest impact is contemporaneous, though months later in the year also experience statistically and economically meaningful growth. Once dynamic effects are accounted for, we estimate that an additional rig-count results in the creation of 37 jobs immediately and 224 jobs in the long run, though our robustness checks suggest that these multipliers could be bigger.
abstract_zh: 21世纪头十年，油气勘探与生产方面的技术进步带动了上游投资的繁荣，并增加了国内化石燃料的供应。然而，这一繁荣创造了多少就业岗位尚不清楚。我们在国家层面采用时间序列方法，在州层面采用动态面板方法，以理解勘探与生产活动的增加如何影响就业。我们发现，有力的统计证据支持以下假设：以钻机数量衡量的石油和天然气钻探变化，确实对就业产生了具有经济意义的正向影响。最强的影响是同期的，但在年内数月之后也出现了统计上和经济上均有意义的增长。考虑动态效应之后，我们估计每增加一台钻机，即刻可创造37个就业岗位，长期可创造224个就业岗位；不过，我们的稳健性检验表明，这些乘数可能更大。

title: Energy Sector Innovation and Growth
abstract: We study the optimal transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy in a neoclassical growth economy with endogenous technological progress in energy production. Innovations keep fossil energy costs under control even as increased exploitation raises mining costs. Nevertheless, the economy transitions to renewable energy after about 80% of available fossil fuels are exploited. The energy shadow price remains more than double current values for over 75 years around the switch time. Consumption and output growth decline sharply during the transition period, which we thus identify as an “energy crisis.” The model highlights the important role energy can play in influencing economic growth.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在一个内生技术进步的新古典增长经济体中，能源生产由化石燃料向可再生能源的最优转型。创新使化石能源成本保持在可控范围内，即使过度开采会提高开采成本。尽管如此，经济体仍会在约80%的可用化石燃料被开采之后转向可再生能源。在转换时点前后的较长时期内（超过75年），能源影子价格仍保持在当前水平的两倍以上。在转型期间，消费和产出增长急剧下降，我们将这一时期称为“能源危机”。该模型凸显了能源在影响经济增长方面可以发挥的重要作用。

title: Monetary Emissions Trading Mechanisms
abstract: Trade in permits has been proposed, and in some cases implemented, as a tool to reduce pollution. We use a dynamic framework from monetary theory to model permits. We derive properties of optimal permits trading mechanisms under private information concerning the firms’ tendency to pollute. When the firms’ capital vintage is fixed, both emissions taxes and trade in permits can support the first‐best. Both policies, however, can fail to achieve efficiency if firms endogenously choose their composition of capital stock across clean and dirty vintages. If permit requirements and taxes depend on the firms’ vintage composition, in addition to ex post emissions, both policies can support efficiency. In both setups, the banking of notes is not necessary and may even break this equivalence in favor of taxes.
abstract_zh: 排放许可证交易已被提议，并在某些情况下已被实施，作为减少污染的工具。我们使用货币理论中的一个动态框架来对许可证进行建模。在企业污染倾向属于私人信息的情况下，我们推导了最优许可证交易机制的性质。当企业的资本设备代际固定时，排放税和许可证交易都可以支持第一最优。然而，如果企业内生地选择其在清洁与肮脏设备代际之间的资本存量构成，这两种政策都可能无法实现效率。如果许可证要求和税收除了取决于事后排放量外，还取决于企业的设备代际构成，那么两种政策都可以支持效率。在这两种设定中，票据的储存并非必要，甚至可能打破这一等价关系，并使税收更为有利。

title: Robust Dynamic Energy Use and Climate Change
abstract: We study a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model in which agents are concerned about model uncertainty regarding climate change. An externality from greenhouse gas emissions damages the economy's capital stock. We assume that the mapping from climate change to damages is subject to uncertainty, as opposed to risk, and we use robust control to study efficiency and optimal policy. We obtain a sharp analytical solution for the implied environmental externality and characterize dynamic optimal taxation. The optimal tax that restores the socially optimal allocation is Pigouvian. We study optimal output growth in the presence and in the absence of concerns about model uncertainty, and find that these can lead to substantially different conclusions regarding the optimal emissions and the optimal mix of fossil fuel. In particular, the optimal use of coal will be significantly lower on a robust path, while the optimal use of oil/gas will edge down.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个动态随机一般均衡模型，其中行为主体关注气候变化的模型不确定性。温室气体排放的外部性会损害经济的资本存量。我们假设从气候变化到损害之间的映射关系存在的是不确定性，而非风险，并利用稳健控制方法研究效率和最优政策。我们得到了所隐含的环境外部性的清晰解析解，并刻画了动态最优税收。恢复社会最优配置的最优税收是庇古税。我们研究了在存在和不存在模型不确定性担忧两种情况下的最优产出增长路径，发现二者可能导致关于最优排放量和最优化石燃料组合的实质性不同结论。特别地，在稳健路径下，煤炭的最优使用量将显著降低，而石油和天然气的最优使用量将略有下降。

title: Local Employment Impact from Competing Energy Sources: Shale Gas versus Wind Generation in Texas
New Alignments? The Geopolitics of Gas and Oil Cartels and the Changing Middle East
venue: Economics of Energy and Environmental Policy
abstract: The ongoing democratic movements and civil wars in the Middle East have challenged the stability of regimes across the region. On the other hand, the commercial exploitation of large reserves of unconventional oil and gas in the United States is poised to significantly change the current equilibrium in energy markets. What are the implications of these developments on Saudi Arabia's energy policy? Will the long-standing U.S.-Saudi alliance remain the cornerstone of the kingdom's relationship with the outside world? We study these questions using a game-theoretic approach. Specifically, we investigate whether the new political and economic trends may warm the Saudi regime to a workable energy cartel with Russia. We analyze the outcomes from different coalitions that could form among major energy suppliers and show that this is indeed a possibility. We discuss the implications of our results for U.S. policy toward Saudi Arabia.
abstract_zh: 中东地区正在进行的民主运动和内战，已经对该地区各国政权的稳定构成挑战。另一方面，美国非常规石油和天然气的商业开采，有望显著改变当前的能源市场均衡。这些发展对沙特阿拉伯的能源政策有何影响？长期存在的美沙联盟能否继续作为该王国对外关系的基石？我们运用博弈论方法研究这些问题。具体而言，我们考察了新的政治和经济趋势是否可能促使沙特政权与俄罗斯形成一个可行的能源卡特尔。我们分析了主要能源供应国之间可能形成的不同联盟的结果，并表明这确实是一种可能性。我们讨论了研究结果对美国对沙特阿拉伯政策的启示。
